headline: Quantum Foundations Meet Low-Background Particle Physics
summary: Today's research spans diverse foundational frontiers, featuring deep analytical proofs in quantum information theory, advanced quantum battery and anyon protocols, alongside concrete material testing for dark matter detectors and financial volatility modeling.

themes.title: Quantum Information and Complexity
themes.body: Several papers advance quantum information theory, investigating maximal distance measures, spectrum-based converse bounds for state discrimination, semi-Cliffordness in composite dimensions, and distributional quantum query complexity.

themes.title: Quantum Hardware and Topology
themes.body: New developments in quantum technologies explore boundary-accessible work in topological quantum batteries using dimerized spin chains, and minimal circuit resources utilizing qudit resets for non-Abelian anyon fusion.

themes.title: Astrophysical Detection and Financial Mathematics
themes.body: Applied physics and mathematical finance contributions test optical coupling materials for the SABRE-North dark matter detector and resolve wing limit conjectures for the SABR volatility model.
